# Muhammad Faheem Arshad (Fahim Arshad)

> AI Systems Engineer, AI Solution Architect and Engineering Manager based in Lahore, Pakistan, with 10+ years of experience. Currently AI Solution Architect & Engineering Manager at Refocus AI. Builds AI agents, agentic business automation, multi-LLM systems and scalable Node.js/TypeScript platforms, and leads engineering teams.

Also known as: Faheem Arshad, Fahim Arshad, M Faheem Arshad, Faheem, Fahim.
Website: https://www.imfahim.com
Email: dev.imfaheem@gmail.com
LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/imfahim-arshad/
GitHub: https://github.com/devimfaheem

## What he does

- AI Systems Engineering: production AI systems — multi-LLM routing across models such as Claude and Gemini, AI agents, reviewer agents that verify AI output, observability.
- Agentic Automation: AI agents that automate business workflows end to end — document extraction, validation, browser automation, human-in-the-loop review.
- AI Solution Architecture: scalable, cost-efficient architectures — microservices, queue-based processing (RabbitMQ/SQS), AWS/Azure, LLM integration.
- Engineering Leadership: leads and mentors engineering teams (8+ engineers), sets code-quality standards, aligns technical roadmaps with business goals.

## Experience

- AI Solution Architect & Engineering Manager, Refocus AI (Mar 2025 – present, remote): leads an AI engineering team building browser automation and multi-LLM pipelines; reviewer-agent layers; microservices and queue-based architecture; Datadog observability.
- Managing Consultant / Tech Lead, Systems Ltd (Jul 2023 – Mar 2025): high-traffic news platform (millions of monthly users, 10k+ concurrent users) on Node.js, NestJS, Next.js, MySQL; CRM products with Angular; led a team of 8+.
- Principal Software Engineer, Confiz Ltd (Jan 2021 – Jul 2023): Node.js/NestJS with Domain-Driven Design; React and Angular component libraries; RabbitMQ queues cut server load by 30%.
- Senior Software Engineer, Strategic Systems International (Feb 2020 – Jan 2021).
- Software Engineer, Dubizzle Labs / Zameen.com (Oct 2016 – Jan 2020).
- Software Engineer, Stellar Technologies (Jan 2016 – Oct 2016).
